summary: This module allows administrators to define and manage various earning (e.g., allowances) and deduction (e.g., fines) heads that can be used in salary calculations and contracts.
steps: Navigate to 'Settings > HRM Setup > Payroll Master'.
You will see options for 'Earning Heads' and 'Deduction Heads'.

To add an earning head: Click on 'Earning Heads'. Check if the desired head (e.g., HRA, Medical Allowance) is already listed. If so, tick it and save. If not, click 'Add New', enter the 'Name' of the new head, and click 'Save'.
To add a deduction head: Click on 'Deduction Heads'. Check if the desired head is already listed. If not, click 'Add New', enter the 'Name' of the new head, and click 'Save'.
Always click 'Save' after making changes to ensure they are applied.
business_rules: Heads created here become available for selection in salary templates and during monthly salary adjustments.
important_notes: Creating a new head here does not automatically update existing salary templates or processed salaries; it only makes the head available for future use.
The 'Payroll Master' is central to defining all components of salary and deductions within the HRM module.
